:module.eks_blueprints_kubernetes_addons: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_s3_object.this is redundant — already implied by attribute references

`module.eks_blueprints_kubernetes_addons` has an explicit `depends_on` on `:resource.aws_s3_object.this`, but this dependency is already established implicitly: the module's `spark_history_server_helm_config` variable (via `module.eks_blueprints_kubernetes_addons:var.spark_history_server_helm_config`) interpolates `aws_s3_object.this.key` in the Spark history server Helm values, which the graph already records as an implicit dependency. The `depends_on` entry can be removed; the other S3 entries in that `depends_on` (ACL, public access block, SSE configuration) are NOT redundant since no attribute reference implies them.

`module.eks_blueprints.module.emr_on_eks:resource.null_resource.update_trust_policy` has an explicit `depends_on` on `module.eks_blueprints.module.emr_on_eks:resource.aws_iam_role.emr_on_eks_execution`, but the local-exec command already interpolates `${aws_iam_role.emr_on_eks_execution.id}`, which Terraform records as an implicit dependency (`implicit_deps`). The explicit `depends_on` entry duplicates it and can be removed.

`module.eks_blueprints.module.emr_on_eks:resource.null_resource.update_trust_policy` has an explicit `depends_on` on `module.eks_blueprints.module.emr_on_eks:resource.kubernetes_namespace.spark`, but the command string already references `${kubernetes_namespace.spark.id}` (`--namespace ${kubernetes_namespace.spark.id}`), which is recorded as an implicit dependency. The explicit `depends_on` entry duplicates it and can be removed.

`module.eks_blueprints.module.aws_eks_managed_node_groups:resource.aws_eks_node_group.managed_ng` has an explicit `depends_on` on `module.eks_blueprints.module.aws_eks_managed_node_groups:resource.aws_iam_role.managed_ng`, but the node group's `node_role_arn` attribute already references `aws_iam_role.managed_ng[0].arn`, which the graph records as an implicit dependency. The `aws_iam_instance_profile.managed_ng` and `aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.managed_ng` entries in the same `depends_on` are NOT redundant (no attribute reference implies them) and should be kept.
